notes.title: Fixed achievement related issues
notes.content: Fixed an issue where achievement on Steam were sometimes out of sync with Gamelet badges.

notes.title: 2nd Season of missions are now available!!!
notes.content:
The second season of Twilight Wars story has finally launched on Steam!
Eight chapters, 24 missions are now fully available. New challenges await, ready for you to conquer!

The final chapter of Skydow Warriors is scheduled to be remastered and release this summer.

notes.title: The missions in chapter two are now published!
notes.content: The missions in chapter two are now published!

notes.title: You can review your chapter achievement in the mission list page
notes.content:
You can review your chapter achievement in the mission list page.
Click the badge to retrieve the steam achievement if you somehow lost it.

notes.title: Bug Fix: Mission mode with multiplayer issue
notes.content:
Multiplayers playing mission mode caused serious lag. This bug has been fixed.
Please update your game to get the fix.
(You may want to restart your steam app, so the game gets updated immediately).
